business.description: GP Petroleums Limited specializes in the formulation, manufacturing and marketing of Industrial Lubricants, Automotive Lubricants, Rubber Process Oils, Transformer Oils, Greases, and other specialties under the brand name 'IPOL'. The company also trades in Bitumen, Base Oil and Fuel Oil.

outlook.statement: India's economic growth story, supported by continued industrialisation, infrastructure development and manufacturing expansion, presents significant opportunities. Global markets continue to offer new avenues for the IPOL brand and specialty products. Priorities: strengthen leadership in existing markets, expand into new geographies, improve operational efficiencies, embrace digital transformation, enhance sustainability initiatives, continue delivering superior value. Near-term headwinds: sharp increase in crude-linked raw material costs and currency weakness from geopolitical developments in Q4 FY2025-26, posing short-to-medium-term challenges.

Prospects of growth in the lubricants industry are favorable, underpinned by increase in industrial activity, number of vehicles, infrastructure development, and increasing demand for high-quality lubricants. Slow but definite trend towards synthetic lubricants, specialty fluids, and custom lubricants. Gradual movement towards electric mobility could change demand pattern in conventional lubricants but present opportunities in thermal fluids and greases.
Industrial Lubricants outlook appears favorable due to increased industrial activities, infrastructure development, manufacturing activities, and increasing need for high-performance lubricants.
Rubber Process Oils prospects seem positive due to growth in demand from tyre and rubber industry, preference for performance and eco-friendly process oils, and potential in export markets.
Automotive Lubricants growth supported by robust Indian auto industry, rising vehicle ownership, larger registered vehicles, and increased importance of preventive maintenance.
Bitumen business expected to see sustained demand due to government focus on infrastructure (PM Gati Shakti, Bharatmala Pariyojana, National Infrastructure Pipeline).

Directors remain confident of the Company's long-term growth prospects. Backed by a strong balance sheet, a diversified product portfolio and a continued focus on innovation, operational excellence and customer satisfaction, the Company is well-positioned to capitalise on emerging opportunities and deliver sustainable value to all stakeholders.

Diversification initiatives in bitumen segment (JV with West Coast Oils LLP, HPCL/BPCL/IOCL supply agreements, Savli facility acquisition) represent significant milestones and are expected to support long-term growth in India's expanding infrastructure sector.
The Company undertakes no obligation to publicly update or revise any forward-looking statements, whether as a result of new information, future events or otherwise.
